summary: The regime filter is off (SPY 1.12% under its 200-day), so the only buys allowed are BND, GLD, IEF and TLT. BND and IEF are wash-sale blocked, and the Market Analyst says not to use GLD as a haven (5d -5.64%, 17.82% under its 200-day). That leaves one proposal: a $20 TLT add on his explicit duration preference, now backed by a week in which TLT rose 2.91% while SPY fell 2.39%. I checked every held position against its stop block (no stop_alerts, nothing tripped) and every stored qualitative clause (none met; details below), so I propose no sells. About 52% cash stays idle because the regime filter blocks equity buys, not because of any invalidated position. Lessons applied: L7 (clause-by-clause check), L4 (the add is not token-sized and rests on the Market Analyst's explicit preference), L9 (TLT has its own stop), L6 (stop measured against the blended cost after the add) and L2 (earnings dates taken from the News Analyst's filings check). Held-book review per L7: CARG 13.9% above its $28.25 stop with no guidance cut or 8-K (reported 11-05, next 2027-02-18). DPZ 18.4% above its $300 stop and still rank 3 on today's menu. BNP's Underperform/$295 initiation and the EVP sale are sentiment, not a guidance cut or 8-K, so the clause is unmet. DPZ is the largest weight at 12% but has a 0.12 beta, and it is a long-term-taxable winner with no tripped clause. IDXX 7.35% above its $640 stop with no filing. INCY 6.7% above its $110 stop with no failed pivotal trial or guidance cut. KR 9.2% above its $61.50 stop; the cyber incident is unconfirmed, the Grubhub contact has no bid or 8-K, and the 12-03 call enters the 5-day window on 11-25, so do not add to KR. MSCI 12.7% above its stop with no 8-K. SAM 5.0% above its $201 stop, still on the menu, with no guidance-cut 8-K. Its 11-19 8-K 5.02 is still unread, and its stored thesis still says it 'joins WMT and KR' after the WMT sale, which the PM should fix through thesis_updates (L6). TLT 7.1% above its $76.30 stop, and its duration clause is unmet: TLT 5d +2.91% and IEF 5d +1.55% are both positive while SPY 5d is -2.39%. VRSN 12.9% above its $278 stop with no filing. CARG and VRSN sit in buckets on the Market Analyst's avoid list (Communication, Technology), but their stored theses already rest on quality and low beta, not a sector role (L8). For the PM: restate TLT's stop from the blended cost, carried over from 11-23.

proposals.thesis: The Market Analyst's same-day note is risk-off (0.55). He says Treasuries are 'the one sleeve working' and tells the book to 'lean on duration'. This week's figures support him: TLT 5d +2.91% and IEF +1.55% while SPY fell 2.39%, so long yields are falling as stocks fall, a change from mid-November. TLT is the only duration sleeve available: the regime filter allows only BND, GLD, IEF and TLT, BND and IEF are wash-sale blocked, and he says to avoid GLD. The add is $20, about 3.3% of equity, against a $56.64 cap. It takes TLT from about 5.8% to about 9% of equity and moves part of the roughly 52% filter-idled cash into the one sleeve the Market Analyst favors (L4: this rests on his explicit preference, not on diversification alone). Caveats he names himself: TLT is still 1.11% under its 200-day, so the rally has not reclaimed the longer trend, and credit is calm. TLT is also the most volatile Treasury option (vol_252d 0.098). The add brings more long-duration rate risk that the equity stress test does not show, and the 12-09 FOMC falls inside the 20-session test. The size is held below the cap for those reasons. ETF, no earnings events (News Analyst). TLT keeps its own stop and shares none with another holding (L9). Holiday week: closed 11-26, half day 11-27.
proposals.invalidation: TLT closes at or below $76.30 (about 6.6% under the $81.69 reference close and about 5.9% under the expected blended cost near $81.1 after this add; the PM should restate the stop from the actual blended cost at the next run), or at any run TLT's and IEF's 5-day returns are both negative while SPY's 5-day return is also negative (duration no longer hedging, per the Market Analyst's figures).
